svg.title: Dependency-aware execution: preserve recurrent order
svg.desc: Four logical lanes show MMA, input load, update with required stores, and cast/state-ready over three timesteps. Purple edges retain next-MMA and next-update dependencies. A separate dashed candidate strip shows issue, ready, consume and reuse without measured time units.

text.tspan: (b) Independent input prefetch: PROPOSED overlap window
Logical execution order - not to scale; no measured overlap or speedup implied
h_t feeds the next MMA; c[,n,m] also feed the next update. C_t is absent in inference.
TBD: prefetch backend, independent resources, buffer protocol and measured overlap.
